title: Mini POS assignments
subtitle: Which promoter works at which pharmacy, on which days and for how many hours a day.

access.deniedTitle: No access to Mini POS assignments
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Mini POS operations grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

failed: SIS.Api did not answer. Try again in a moment.

today.title: Today
today.empty: No promoter is assigned to a pharmacy today.
today.failedTitle: Today's assignments could not be read

overlap.title: These days overlap another assignment
overlap.detail: {{promoter}} is already assigned to pharmacy {{store}} from {{from}} to {{to}}. End that assignment or choose other days.

add.title: Add an assignment
add.promoterHint: The promoter's sign-in ID (their SAP number).

problem.past: An assignment starts today or later.
problem.order: The last day comes on or after the first.
problem.hours: Enter the planned hours a day, more than 0 and at most 24.

find.title: Find assignments
find.failedTitle: The assignments could not be read

end.title: End this assignment?
end.body: {{promoter}} will no longer be assigned to pharmacy {{store}}. It applies at the promoter's next sign-in; the row is kept.

endPromoter.title: End this promoter now?
endPromoter.body: Every current and future assignment of {{promoter}} ends, and the promoter is signed out of Mini POS on their phone at once.

done.title: {{promoter}} ended
done.detail: Assignments ended: {{rows}}. Phone sessions signed out: {{sessions}}.

refusal.past: An assignment starts today or later, and a past one cannot be ended.
refusal.promoterUnknown: No user has this login ID. Create the promoter first.
refusal.storeNotEnabled: This pharmacy does not run Mini POS. Enable it on the Pharmacies screen first.
refusal.notFound: This assignment no longer exists. Refresh the list.
